tr.sahih: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
tr.pickthall: Ta. Sin. Mim.

tr.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.
tr.pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.

ayahs.text: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
tr.pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.

ayahs.text: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ

tr.sahih: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
tr.pickthall: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.

ayahs.text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

tr.sahih: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
tr.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.

ayahs.text: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

tr.sahih: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
tr.pickthall: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.

ayahs.text: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
tr.pickthall: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.text: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
tr.pickthall: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,

tr.sahih: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
tr.pickthall: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,

ayahs.text: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ

tr.sahih: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
tr.pickthall: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).

ayahs.text: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

tr.sahih: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
tr.pickthall: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.

ayahs.text: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
tr.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.

ayahs.text: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
tr.pickthall: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,

tr.sahih: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
tr.pickthall: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.

ayahs.text: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,

ayahs.text: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
tr.pickthall: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
tr.pickthall: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.

ayahs.text: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
tr.pickthall: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).

ayahs.text: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

tr.sahih: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
tr.pickthall: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.

tr.sahih: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
tr.pickthall: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
tr.pickthall: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.

ayahs.text: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
tr.pickthall: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"
tr.pickthall: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!

ayahs.text: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
tr.pickthall: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,

ayahs.text: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
tr.pickthall: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.

ayahs.text: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,

ayahs.text: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

tr.sahih: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
tr.pickthall: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
tr.pickthall: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners

tr.sahih: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
tr.pickthall: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.

tr.sahih: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
tr.pickthall: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.

tr.sahih: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.
tr.pickthall: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?

ayahs.text: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

tr.sahih: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
tr.pickthall: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.

ayahs.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
tr.pickthall: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?

ayahs.text: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

words.gloss: the ones who are brought near

tr.sahih: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
tr.pickthall: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

tr.sahih: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
tr.pickthall: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!

ayahs.text: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

tr.sahih: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
tr.pickthall: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.

ayahs.text: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

tr.sahih: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
tr.pickthall: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.

tr.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
tr.pickthall: And the wizards were flung prostrate,

tr.sahih: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
tr.pickthall: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

tr.sahih: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
tr.pickthall: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

ayahs.text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

words.gloss: and I will surely crucify you

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
tr.pickthall: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.

ayahs.text: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

tr.sahih: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
tr.pickthall: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.

tr.sahih: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
tr.pickthall: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,

tr.sahih: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
tr.pickthall: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,

tr.sahih: And indeed, they are enraging us,
tr.pickthall: And lo! they are offenders against us.

tr.sahih: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
tr.pickthall: And lo! we are a ready host.

tr.sahih: So We removed them from gardens and springs
tr.pickthall: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,

tr.sahih: And treasures and honorable station -
tr.pickthall: And treasures and a fair estate.

words.gloss: And We caused to inherit them

tr.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
tr.pickthall: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

tr.sahih: So they pursued them at sunrise.
tr.pickthall: And they overtook them at sunrise.

ayahs.text: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

tr.sahih: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
tr.pickthall: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.

ayahs.text: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
tr.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.

ayahs.text: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
tr.pickthall: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.

tr.sahih: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
tr.pickthall: Then brought We near the others to that place.

tr.sahih: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
tr.pickthall: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;

tr.sahih: Then We drowned the others.
tr.pickthall: And We drowned the others.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

tr.sahih: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
tr.pickthall: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:

ayahs.text: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
tr.pickthall: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.

tr.sahih: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
tr.pickthall: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?

tr.sahih: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
tr.pickthall: Or do they benefit or harm you?

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
tr.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.

tr.sahih: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
tr.pickthall: He said: See now that which ye worship,

tr.sahih: You and your ancient forefathers?
tr.pickthall: Ye and your forefathers!

ayahs.text: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
tr.pickthall: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,

tr.sahih: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
tr.pickthall: Who created me, and He doth guide me,

tr.sahih: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
tr.pickthall: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.

tr.sahih: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
tr.pickthall: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,

tr.sahih: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
tr.pickthall: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),

ayahs.text: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

tr.sahih: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
tr.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.

ayahs.text: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
tr.pickthall: And give unto me a good report in later generations.

tr.sahih: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
tr.pickthall: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,

ayahs.text: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
tr.pickthall: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.

tr.sahih: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
tr.pickthall: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
tr.pickthall: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

tr.sahih: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
tr.pickthall: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.

tr.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
tr.pickthall: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).

tr.sahih: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
tr.pickthall: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.

ayahs.text: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
tr.pickthall: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

ayahs.text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
tr.pickthall: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?

tr.sahih: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
tr.pickthall: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers

tr.sahih: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
tr.pickthall: And the hosts of Iblis, together.

tr.sahih: They will say while they dispute therein,
tr.pickthall: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:

ayahs.text: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
tr.pickthall: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest

tr.sahih: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.

tr.sahih: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
tr.pickthall: It was but the guilty who misled us.

tr.sahih: So now we have no intercessors
tr.pickthall: Now we have no intercessors

tr.sahih: And not a devoted friend.
tr.pickthall: Nor any loving friend.

ayahs.text: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."
tr.pickthall: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied the messengers
tr.pickthall: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),

ayahs.text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr.pickthall: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

tr.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

tr.sahih: So fear Allāh and obey me.
tr.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

tr.sahih: So fear Allāh and obey me."
tr.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

tr.sahih: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
tr.pickthall: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?

ayahs.text: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
tr.pickthall: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?

ayahs.text: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

tr.sahih: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
tr.pickthall: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;

tr.sahih: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
tr.pickthall: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.

tr.sahih: I am only a clear warner."
tr.pickthall: I am only a plain warner.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
tr.pickthall: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.

ayahs.text: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
tr.pickthall: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.

ayahs.text: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

tr.sahih: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
tr.pickthall: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

tr.sahih: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
tr.pickthall: Then afterward We drowned the others.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

tr.sahih: ʿAad denied the messengers
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).

ayahs.text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr.pickthall: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

tr.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

tr.sahih: So fear Allāh and obey me.
tr.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

tr.sahih: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
tr.pickthall: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?

tr.sahih: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
tr.pickthall: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?

tr.sahih: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
tr.pickthall: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?

tr.sahih: So fear Allāh and obey me.
tr.pickthall: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

tr.sahih: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
tr.pickthall: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,

tr.sahih: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
tr.pickthall: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.

tr.sahih: And gardens and springs.
tr.pickthall: And gardens and watersprings.

ayahs.text: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
tr.pickthall: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
tr.pickthall: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;

tr.sahih: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
tr.pickthall: This is but a fable of the men of old,

tr.sahih: And we are not to be punished."
tr.pickthall: And we shall not be doomed.

ayahs.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

tr.sahih: Thamūd denied the messengers
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

ayahs.text: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr.pickthall: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

tr.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

tr.sahih: So fear Allāh and obey me.
tr.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

tr.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

tr.sahih: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
tr.pickthall: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,

tr.sahih: Within gardens and springs
tr.pickthall: In gardens and watersprings.

tr.sahih: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
tr.pickthall: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,

tr.sahih: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
tr.pickthall: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?

tr.sahih: So fear Allāh and obey me.
tr.pickthall: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,

tr.sahih: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
tr.pickthall: And obey not the command of the prodigal,

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

tr.sahih: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
tr.pickthall: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.

tr.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
tr.pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

ayahs.text: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

ayahs.text: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
tr.pickthall: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

tr.sahih: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

tr.sahih: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
tr.pickthall: And weigh with the true balance.

ayahs.text: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
tr.pickthall: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.

tr.sahih: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
tr.pickthall: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.

tr.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
tr.pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

tr.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
tr.pickthall: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.

ayahs.text: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
tr.pickthall: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.

ayahs.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
tr.pickthall: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

tr.sahih: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,

tr.sahih: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
tr.pickthall: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

tr.sahih: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners -
tr.pickthall: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,

tr.sahih: In a clear Arabic language.
tr.pickthall: In plain Arabic speech.

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.

ayahs.text: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

tr.sahih: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
tr.pickthall: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?

tr.sahih: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
tr.pickthall: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,

ayahs.text: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
tr.pickthall: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

tr.sahih: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
tr.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.

ayahs.text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

tr.sahih: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,

words.gloss: And it will come to them

tr.sahih: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
tr.pickthall: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.

tr.sahih: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
tr.pickthall: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?

words.gloss: So is it for Our punishment

tr.sahih: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
tr.pickthall: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?

tr.sahih: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
tr.pickthall: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,

tr.sahih: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
tr.pickthall: And then cometh that which they were promised,

ayahs.text: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

tr.sahih: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
tr.pickthall: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
tr.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners

tr.sahih: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
tr.pickthall: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.

tr.sahih: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
tr.pickthall: The devils did not bring it down.

tr.sahih: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
tr.pickthall: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,

tr.sahih: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
tr.pickthall: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.

ayahs.text: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

tr.sahih: So do not invoke with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
tr.pickthall: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.

tr.sahih: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
tr.pickthall: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,

ayahs.text: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
tr.pickthall: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.

ayahs.text: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
tr.pickthall: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.

tr.sahih: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
tr.pickthall: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.

tr.sahih: Who sees you when you arise
tr.pickthall: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)

tr.sahih: And your movement among those who prostrate.
tr.pickthall: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).

tr.sahih: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr.pickthall: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

ayahs.text: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ

tr.sahih: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
tr.pickthall: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

tr.sahih: They descend upon every sinful liar.
tr.pickthall: They descend on every sinful, false one.

tr.sahih: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
tr.pickthall: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.

tr.sahih: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
tr.pickthall: As for poets, the erring follow them.

ayahs.text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

tr.sahih: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,

tr.sahih: And that they say what they do not do? -
tr.pickthall: And how they say that which they do not?

ayahs.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
tr.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
